source.title: Revamp /punish With Automatic Five-Tier Escalation, Hyphenated Rule Keywords, and Staff Rank Permissions
source.body:
```
@claude

# Revamp /punish With Automatic Escalation, Rule Keywords, and Staff Permissions

GAMEMODE: BOTH (Survival and Lifesteal)

Read CLAUDE.md before making changes.

## OBJECTIVE

Completely revamp JoshyMC's existing /punish system.

Staff should only need to execute:

/punish <player> <rule>

Examples:
/punish Steve spam
/punish Steve hacking
/punish Steve claim-abuse
/punish Steve credit-voucher-abuse
/punish Steve combat-logging

The system must automatically:
1. Identify the rule broken.
2. Retrieve the player's previous qualifying offenses.
3. Determine the next punishment tier.
4. Verify staff permissions.
5. Display a confirmation GUI.
6. Apply the punishment after confirmation.
7. Save the offense persistently.
8. Escalate future offenses automatically.

IMPORTANT: Multiple-word rule keywords MUST be lowercase and separated by hyphens.

Examples:
- credit-voucher-abuse
- claim-abuse
- combat-logging
- inappropriate-content

Do NOT use creditvoucherabuse, claimabuse, or other concatenated names as canonical keywords.

==================================================
1. PLAYER-FACING PUNISHMENT REASONS
==================================================

The player's ban, mute, kick, or warning message must use the readable name of the rule, NOT the command keyword.

Examples:

Command:
/punish Steve credit-voucher-abuse

Player sees:
Reason: Credit Voucher Abuse

Command:
/punish Steve spam

Player sees:
Reason: Spamming

Command:
/punish Steve hacking

Player sees:
Reason: Hacking or Cheating

Command:
/punish Steve claim-abuse

Player sees:
Reason: Claim Abuse

Each rule must store:
- Stable numerical rule ID
- Canonical command keyword
- Readable display name
- Rule category
- Five punishment tiers
- Gamemode applicability

Example ban screen:

JOSHYMC | YOU HAVE BEEN BANNED

Reason: Credit Voucher Abuse
Duration: 7 Days
Offense: 1

Appeal through the official JoshyMC appeal process.

For a permanent ban:

JOSHYMC | PERMANENTLY BANNED

Reason: Hacking or Cheating
Duration: Permanent

Never show raw command keywords as player-facing punishment reasons.

Use the existing JoshyMC message formatting conventions.

==================================================
2. COMPLETE RULE KEYWORD REGISTRY
==================================================

Implement the following 73 rules.

Format:
Rule ID | Command Keyword | Player-Facing Reason

GENERAL GAMEPLAY
1 | hacking | Hacking or Cheating
2 | automation | Unauthorized Gameplay Automation
3 | duping | Duplication or Exploitation
4 | exploit-concealment | Concealing Serious Exploits
5 | aiding-cheaters | Aiding Cheaters or Exploiters

ACCOUNT RULES
6 | account-limit | Exceeding Account Limit
7 | alt-abuse | Alt Account Abuse
8 | ban-evasion | Punishment Evasion

ECONOMY

10 | market-manipulation | Artificial Market Manipulation
11 | auction-abuse | Auction House Abuse
12 | buy-order-abuse | Buy Order Abuse
13 | selling-abuse | Selling System Abuse
14 | irl-trading | Unauthorized IRL Trading

CREDITS, RANKS & VOUCHERS

16 | credit-voucher-abuse | Credit Voucher Abuse
17 | rank-voucher-abuse | Rank Voucher Abuse
18 | tag-voucher-abuse | Chat Tag Voucher Abuse

CRATES

20 | fake-crate-keys | Forged or Duplicated Crate Keys
21 | crate-selection-abuse | Crate Selection Abuse

SPAWNERS
22 | spawner-info | Informational Only

24 | spawner-stealing | Bypassing Spawner Ownership

CLAIMS & BUILDING
25 | claim-abuse | Claim Abuse
26 | protected-griefing | Griefing Protected Areas
27 | block-protection-abuse | Block Protection Abuse
28 | inappropriate-build | Inappropriate Builds

REGIONS
29 | region-info | Informational Only
30 | region-abuse | Region Boundary Abuse
31 | safe-zone-abuse | Safe Zone Abuse
32 | arena-info | Informational Only

PVP
33 | combat-logging | Combat Logging
34 | stat-boosting | Stat Boosting
35 | bounty-farming | Bounty Farming

TEAMS
36 | team-abuse | Team System Abuse
37 | team-bank-abuse | Team Bank Abuse
38 | team-boosting | Team Kill Boosting

KITS
39 | kit-abuse | Kit Cooldown Abuse
40 | kit-duping | Kit Duplication
41 | staff-kit-abuse | Unauthorized Staff Kit Editing

QUESTS
42 | quest-abuse | Quest Exploitation
43 | streak-abuse | Login Streak Abuse
44 | quest-master-abuse | Quest Master Reward Abuse

STOCK MARKET
45 | stock-info | Informational Only
46 | stock-abuse | Stock Market Exploitation
47 | stock-alt-abuse | Stock Alt Account Abuse

AUCTIONS & BUY ORDERS
48 | illegal-listing | Illegal Auction Listings
49 | escrow-abuse | Escrow or Refund Abuse
50 | rank-limit-abuse | Bypassing Rank Limits

CHAT
51 | harassment | Harassment or Disrespect
52 | spam | Spamming
53 | advertising | Unauthorized Advertising
54 | filter-bypass | Chat Filter Bypassing
55 | inappropriate-content | Inappropriate Content

COMMANDS & GUIS

58 | command-exploit | Command Exploitation

ITEMS

60 | item-data-abuse | Custom Item Data Manipulation
61 | hidden-illegal-items | Concealing Illegal Items

SERVER PERFORMANCE

63 | laggy-farm | Excessively Laggy Farms
64 | server-crashing | Intentional Server Crashing

STAFF & ENFORCEMENT
65 | staff-disrespect | Refusing Staff Instructions
66 | false-evidence | False Evidence During Investigations
67 | staff-interference | Interfering With Moderation
68 | appeal-info | Informational Only

LOOPHOLES
69 | rule-intent | Informational Only
70 | loophole-info | Informational Only
71 | attempted-exploit | Attempted Exploitation
72 | encouraging-violations | Encouraging Rule Breaking
73 | reversal-guideline | Informational Only

Informational rules:
22, 29, 32, 45, 68, 69, 70, 73

These rules must NOT allow direct punishment.

Maintain stable internal rule IDs even though staff use keywords.

==================================================
3. STAFF PERMISSION HIERARCHY
==================================================

Create the following permissions:

joshymc.punish.trainee
joshymc.punish.helper
joshymc.punish.jrmod
joshymc.punish.mod
joshymc.punish.leadmod
joshymc.punish.jradmin
joshymc.punish.admin
joshymc.punish.sradmin

The hierarchy must be:

Trainee
Helper
Jr Mod
Mod
Lead Mod
Jr Admin
Admin
Sr Admin

Higher ranks inherit lower-rank punishment capabilities.

Inspect the actual LuckPerms hierarchy before implementation.

Do not alter unrelated command permissions.

--------------------------------
TRAINEE
--------------------------------

Permission:
joshymc.punish.trainee

Allowed rules:
- spam
- advertising
- filter-bypass
- harassment (minor chat violations)
- inappropriate-content (minor chat violations)

Maximum punishment:
WARNING ONLY

Trainees cannot issue mutes, kicks, or bans through this system.

If a rule's next tier requires a stronger punishment, require higher-ranked staff.

--------------------------------
HELPER
--------------------------------

Permission:
joshymc.punish.helper

Inherits Trainee.

Allowed rules:
- spam
- advertising
- filter-bypass
- harassment
- inappropriate-content
- encouraging-violations (chat-related only)

Maximum punishment:
WARNINGS AND TEMPORARY MUTES

Helpers cannot:
- Kick
- Temporarily ban
- Permanently ban
- Punish hacking
- Punish economy exploitation
- Punish duplication
- Issue network-wide bans

--------------------------------
JR MOD
--------------------------------

Permission:
joshymc.punish.jrmod

Inherits Helper.

Allowed:
- All Helper categories
- Authorized warning reversals

Maximum punishment:
WARNINGS AND TEMPORARY MUTES

No bans.

--------------------------------
MOD
--------------------------------

Permission:
joshymc.punish.mod

Inherits Jr Mod.

Additional allowed rules:
- combat-logging
- stat-boosting
- bounty-farming
- claim-abuse
- protected-griefing
- block-protection-abuse
- inappropriate-build
- region-abuse
- safe-zone-abuse
- team-boosting
- kit-abuse
- streak-abuse
- laggy-farm
- command-abuse
- staff-interference
- false-evidence
- staff-disrespect

Maximum automated temporary ban:
7 DAYS

No permanent bans.

--------------------------------
LEAD MOD
--------------------------------

Permission:
joshymc.punish.leadmod

Inherits Mod.

Additional allowed rules:
- alt-abuse
- account-limit
- aiding-cheaters
- spawner-stealing
- team-abuse
- illegal-listing
- rank-limit-abuse
- illegal-items
- hidden-illegal-items
- ban-evasion

Maximum automated temporary ban:
30 DAYS

Permanent bans require escalation.

--------------------------------
JR ADMIN
--------------------------------

Permission:
joshymc.punish.jradmin

Inherits Lead Mod.

Additional allowed rules:
- hacking
- automation
- duping
- exploit-concealment
- economy-abuse
- market-manipulation
- auction-abuse
- buy-order-abuse
- selling-abuse
- irl-trading
- credit-abuse
- credit-voucher-abuse
- rank-voucher-abuse
- tag-voucher-abuse
- crate-abuse
- fake-crate-keys
- crate-selection-abuse
- spawner-abuse
- team-bank-abuse
- kit-duping
- staff-kit-abuse
- quest-abuse
- quest-master-abuse
- stock-abuse
- stock-alt-abuse
- escrow-abuse
- gui-abuse
- command-exploit
- item-data-abuse
- lag-machine
- attempted-exploit

Maximum automated temporary ban:
30 DAYS

No permanent bans.

--------------------------------
ADMIN
--------------------------------

Permission:
joshymc.punish.admin

Inherits Jr Admin.

Allowed:
ALL ENFORCEABLE RULES

Includes:
- server-crashing

Admins may issue permanent gamemode-specific bans where permitted by existing moderation policies.

Emergency network-wide suspensions:
Maximum 24 hours, with senior review required within 6 hours.

Normal network-wide bans require Manager-or-higher approval.

--------------------------------
SR ADMIN
--------------------------------

Permission:
joshymc.punish.sradmin

Inherits Admin.

Allowed:
ALL ENFORCEABLE RULES

Additional authority:
- High-severity punishment review
- Authorized punishment-tier overrides
- Administrative history corrections
- Serious incident investigations
- Appeal reviews
- Punishment reversals
- Escalation review

Do not automatically grant Manager-level network-ban approval unless existing policy permits it.

--------------------------------
DEVELOPER, MANAGER & OWNER
--------------------------------

Developer is a separate technical role.

Do not automatically grant Developer moderation authority.

Preserve the existing Manager and Owner hierarchy.

Managers and Owner retain established network-wide approval authority.

IMPORTANT:

Permission to use a rule does NOT automatically authorize every punishment tier.

If the calculated punishment exceeds a staff member's maximum authority, block execution and require escalation.

Do NOT substitute a weaker punishment, bypass the tier, or count a pending offense as successfully enforced.

For chat rules involving more serious harassment or content, enforce the higher-level authorization requirement rather than allowing lower staff to classify severe conduct as minor.

==================================================
4. FIVE-TIER PUNISHMENT CONFIGURATION
==================================================

Use these default punishment tiers.

Definitions:
W = Warning
M = Mute
K = Kick
B = Temporary Ban
PB = Permanent Ban

Each row lists tiers 1 through 5 in order.

GENERAL GAMEPLAY
hacking: B7d, B14d, B30d, B90d, PB
automation: W, B1d, B7d, B30d, PB
duping: B7d, B30d, B60d, B90d, PB
exploit-concealment: B3d, B7d, B30d, B90d, PB
aiding-cheaters: B1d, B7d, B14d, B30d, PB

ACCOUNT RULES
account-limit: W, B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d
alt-abuse: W, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB
ban-evasion: Extend existing punishment, +B7d, +B14d, +B30d, PB

ECONOMY
economy-abuse: B3d, B7d, B30d, B90d, PB
market-manipulation: W, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB
auction-abuse: B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB
buy-order-abuse: B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB
selling-abuse: W, B1d, B7d, B30d, PB
irl-trading: B7d, B14d, B30d, B90d, PB

CREDITS, RANKS & VOUCHERS
credit-abuse: B3d, B7d, B30d, B90d, PB
credit-voucher-abuse: B7d, B14d, B30d, B90d, PB
rank-voucher-abuse: B7d, B14d, B30d, B90d, PB
tag-voucher-abuse: W, B1d, B7d, B30d, PB

CRATES
crate-abuse: B3d, B7d, B14d, B30d, PB
fake-crate-keys: B3d, B7d, B30d, B90d, PB
crate-selection-abuse: B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB

SPAWNERS
spawner-abuse: B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB
spawner-stealing: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d

CLAIMS & BUILDING
claim-abuse: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d
protected-griefing: B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB
block-protection-abuse: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d
inappropriate-build: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d

REGIONS
region-abuse: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d
safe-zone-abuse: B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB

PVP
combat-logging: W, B1h, B6h, B1d, B3d
stat-boosting: W, B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d
bounty-farming: W, B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d

TEAMS
team-abuse: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d
team-bank-abuse: B3d, B7d, B14d, B30d, PB
team-boosting: W, B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d

KITS
kit-abuse: W, B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d
kit-duping: B3d, B7d, B14d, B30d, PB
staff-kit-abuse: B7d, B14d, B30d, B90d, PB

QUESTS
quest-abuse: W, B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d
streak-abuse: W, B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d
quest-master-abuse: B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB

STOCK MARKET
stock-abuse: B3d, B7d, B14d, B30d, PB
stock-alt-abuse: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d

AUCTIONS & BUY ORDERS
illegal-listing: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d
escrow-abuse: B3d, B7d, B14d, B30d, PB
rank-limit-abuse: W, B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d

CHAT
harassment: W, M30m, M2h, M12h, M3d
spam: W, M10m, M30m, M1h, M6h
advertising: W, M1h, M6h, M1d, M7d
filter-bypass: W, M10m, M30m, M2h, M12h
inappropriate-content: W, M1h, M6h, B1d, B7d

COMMANDS & GUIS
command-abuse: W, B30m, B3h, B1d, B7d
gui-abuse: B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB
command-exploit: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d

ITEMS
illegal-items: W, B1d, B7d, B30d, PB
item-data-abuse: B3d, B7d, B14d, B30d, PB
hidden-illegal-items: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d

SERVER PERFORMANCE
lag-machine: B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB
laggy-farm: W, B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d
server-crashing: PB, PB, PB, PB, PB

STAFF & ENFORCEMENT
staff-disrespect: W, K, B1h, B1d, B7d
false-evidence: W, B1d, B3d, B14d, B30d
staff-interference: W, K, B1d, B3d, B14d

OTHER
attempted-exploit: W or B1d, B3d, B7d, B30d, PB
encouraging-violations: W, M1h, M1d, B3d, B30d

For attempted-exploit, default Tier 1 to a warning.
A one-day ban requires authorized escalation and documented justification.

For ban-evasion, use safe existing-ban extension logic.
Never shorten an existing punishment.

All punishment tiers must be configurable.

==================================================
5. AUTOMATIC OFFENSE TRACKING
==================================================

Track punishment history by player UUID.

Each offense must store:
- Unique incident ID
- Player UUID
- Rule ID
- Canonical keyword
- Readable display name
- Gamemode
- Punishment scope
- Timestamp
- Issuing staff UUID
- Staff permission level
- Previous qualifying offense count
- Applied punishment tier
- Punishment type
- Duration
- Evidence or incident reference
- Enforcement status
- Appeal/reversal status

Example:

Steve has three previous Spam offenses.

Staff runs:
/punish Steve spam

System determines:
Rule: Spamming
Offense: 4
Punishment: 1-Hour Mute

After successful confirmation, record the offense.

The next qualifying spam violation receives Tier 5.

Use a configurable 90-day escalation window for minor offenses.

Serious offenses should use a longer configurable window.

Keep audit records regardless of escalation-window expiration.

After Tier 5, continue applying the configured Tier 5 punishment unless an authorized policy specifies otherwise.

==================================================
6. CONFIRMATION GUI
==================================================

Running /punish must NOT immediately punish the player.

Open a confirmation GUI.

Example:

JOSHYMC PUNISHMENT CONFIRMATION

Player: Steve
Rule: Credit Voucher Abuse
Gamemode: Survival
Previous Offenses: 1
Current Offense: 2
Punishment: 14-Day Ban
Staff: ExampleAdmin

Buttons:
- Confirm Punishment
- Cancel
- View History

For serious penalties, require an evidence/reference or written justification before confirmation.

The confirmation must:
- Be bound to the initiating staff UUID.
- Use a unique ID.
- Expire after a configurable period.
- Be single-use.
- Recheck staff permissions.
- Recheck the player's offense count.
- Recheck punishment scope.
- Reject stale confirmations.

==================================================
7. GAMEMODE AND NETWORK SCOPE
==================================================

The system must function on BOTH Survival and Lifesteal.

Support:
- Survival-only punishment
- Lifesteal-only punishment
- Network-wide punishment

Default to the gamemode where the violation occurred.

Store the gamemode with each offense.

History should be accessible network-wide to authorized staff.

Qualifying offenses for the same rule may count across both gamemodes.

Example:

Steve spams on Survival:
Tier 1 = Warning

Steve later spams on Lifesteal:
Tier 2 = 10-Minute Mute

The mute applies to Lifesteal, not automatically to Survival.

Normal network-wide bans require Manager-or-higher approval.

Admins may issue emergency network-wide suspensions lasting up to 24 hours, requiring senior review within six hours.

Do not allow automatic escalation to bypass these approval requirements.

Validate whether a rule applies to the gamemode before enforcement.

==================================================
8. DUPLICATE PUNISHMENT PREVENTION
==================================================

Prevent:
- Double-clicking the confirmation GUI.
- Reusing confirmation IDs.
- Two staff punishing one incident twice.
- Concurrent commands incorrectly increasing offense tiers.
- Retry operations duplicating punishment records.
- Restarts replaying completed punishments.
- Aliases creating separate rule histories.

Use:
- Unique incident identifiers.
- Database transactions.
- Idempotent punishment execution.
- Safe concurrency controls.
- Persistent execution state.

If punishment execution fails, do not falsely mark the action as completed.

==================================================
9. APPEALS AND REVERSALS
==================================================

Integrate with existing moderation and appeal systems.

When a punishment is overturned:
- Preserve the audit history.
- Mark the offense overturned.
- Remove invalidated offenses from future escalation counts.
- Restore applicable access.
- Record the authorized reversing staff member.
- Preserve a reason for the reversal.

Existing unmute, unban, and unwarn functionality must continue working according to staff permissions.

Do not erase the historical incident.

==================================================
10. CORRECTIVE ACTIONS
==================================================

Some violations may require:
- Removal of duplicated items.
- Reversal of exploited money.
- Removal of illegitimate Credits.
- Rank corrections.
- Reversal of bounty farming.
- Leaderboard corrections.
- Restoration of protected builds.

Do not automatically wipe player inventories or balances solely because a rule was selected.

Corrective actions require proper authority, evidence, and audit logging.

==================================================
11. COMMANDS AND GUI
==================================================

Required commands:

/punish <player> <rule>
/punish history <player>
/punish history <player> <rule>
/punish preview <player> <rule>
/punish rules
/punish rules <category>
/punish confirm <id>
/punish cancel <id>
/punish reload

Preserve existing compatible legacy commands, including relevant unban, unmute, and unwarn operations.

Tab completion must:
- Display canonical hyphenated keywords.
- Show only authorized rules.
- Exclude informational rules.
- Support offline player resolution where applicable.

The rules GUI must organize offenses by category and show readable rule names.

Every command and GUI action must enforce server-side permissions.

==================================================
12. STAFF AUDIT LOGGING
==================================================

Log:
- Staff UUID
- Target UUID
- Rule ID
- Rule keyword
- Readable rule name
- Gamemode
- Punishment scope
- Previous offense count
- Applied tier
- Punishment type
- Duration
- Confirmation
- Execution outcome
- Evidence/reference
- Reversal or appeal state

Also log:
- Failed enforcement.
- Permission denials.
- Tier overrides.
- Duplicate incident prevention.
- Administrative corrections.
- Network-wide approvals.

Use the existing tamper-resistant moderation audit infrastructure where possible.

==================================================
13. EXISTING SYSTEM COMPATIBILITY
==================================================

Inspect the existing JoshyMC punishment implementation before making changes.

Preserve:
- Existing active bans.
- Existing active mutes.
- Existing warnings.
- Existing appeal records.
- Existing moderation history.
- Existing staff group permissions.
- Existing gamemode isolation.
- Existing network moderation behavior.

Do not create a second incompatible punishment backend.

Do not invent previous offense counts when historical records cannot reliably be mapped to specific rules.

Do not modify unrelated commands, gameplay mechanics, rank rewards, or economic systems.

==================================================
14. TESTING REQUIREMENTS
==================================================

Test command parsing:

/punish Steve spam
/punish Steve hacking
/punish Steve claim-abuse
/punish Steve credit-voucher-abuse
/punish Steve combat-logging

Verify player-facing reasons:

spam -> Spamming
hacking -> Hacking or Cheating
claim-abuse -> Claim Abuse
credit-voucher-abuse -> Credit Voucher Abuse
combat-logging -> Combat Logging

Never display raw keywords in ban reasons.

Test all five tiers of spam:

1. Warning
2. 10-Minute Mute
3. 30-Minute Mute
4. 1-Hour Mute
5. 6-Hour Mute

Test every staff rank:
- Trainee
- Helper
- Jr Mod
- Mod
- Lead Mod
- Jr Admin
- Admin
- Sr Admin

Verify:
- Rank inheritance works.
- Trainees can only issue warnings.
- Helpers can only issue warnings/mutes.
- Jr Mods cannot issue bans.
- Mods cannot exceed 7-day bans.
- Lead Mods cannot exceed 30-day bans.
- Jr Admins cannot permanently ban.
- Admins can handle all enforceable rules.
- Sr Admins can review serious cases.
- Developer gains no unintended moderation authority.
- Unauthorized rules are hidden from suggestions.
- Manually typing unauthorized keywords still fails.

Test:
- Offline punishment targets.
- Persistent history after restart.
- Escalation expiration.
- Shared history across gamemodes.
- Correct gamemode punishment scope.
- Network-wide approval restrictions.
- Duplicate confirmations.
- Concurrent moderation actions.
- Appeal reversals.
- Database failures.
- Permission changes before confirmation.
- Enforcement failures.
- Informational rules cannot trigger punishment.

==================================================
15. IMPLEMENTATION AND PR
==================================================

1. Read CLAUDE.md.
2. Inspect existing moderation architecture.
3. Implement rule registry and readable names.
4. Implement hyphenated command keywords.
5. Implement five-tier punishment configuration.
6. Implement eight rank-specific permission nodes.
7. Implement inherited staff authorization.
8. Implement persistent automatic offense tracking.
9. Implement punishment confirmations.
10. Integrate Survival/Lifesteal and network scope.
11. Integrate existing ban/mute/warn/kick backend.
12. Implement duplicate protection.
13. Implement appeal and reversal handling.
14. Add audit logging.
15. Add relevant automated tests.
16. Run ./gradlew build.
17. Fix implementation-related build failures.
18. Commit and push completed changes.
19. Open a PR referencing this issue.

Do not merge automatically.

Because this issue is large, preserve incremental completed work on the remote branch.

If blocked, document the blocker and preserve the branch instead of silently abandoning the implementation.

==================================================
EXPECTED RESULT
==================================================

A Helper executes:

/punish Steve spam

The system:
- Finds Steve's previous spam violations.
- Determines the next punishment.
- Checks Helper permissions.
- Displays confirmation.
- Applies the punishment if authorized.
- Records the incident.

An Admin executes:

/punish Steve credit-voucher-abuse

The system:
- Recognizes Credit Voucher Abuse.
- Calculates the correct tier.
- Checks Admin permissions.
- Displays confirmation.
- Executes the punishment.
- Records the offense.

Steve's ban screen displays:

Reason: Credit Voucher Abuse

NOT:

Reason: credit-voucher-abuse

The completed system must support both gamemodes, automated escalation, the eight staff permission nodes, secure confirmations, persistent tracking, appeal compatibility, and complete audit logging.

Implement, test, build, push, and open a PR for review.
```
